engine: oversized section word that bleeds off the panel edge (EVER ARCHITECTURE/INTERIOR/TERRITORY, Springs Wellness/Nature/Place). Composes fluid-type-sizing for the fill.

measured_live.EVER: section wordmark 108px @1440 (or a vector logo) filled to width-gutters; letter-spacing -2.16px; clipped reveal from a word-wrap (inner word at y+offset rises to rest); MIRROR LAW: ARCHITECTURE outline, INTERIOR/TERRITORY solid; near-zero parallax between steps (motion at the curtain).
measured_live.three_things_that_make_it_VI: (1) fill the line (fluid-type-sizing), (2) clipped reveal from the bottom edge (overflow:hidden wrap + translateY rise — bleeds), (3) mirror-law fill outline<->solid; + optional slow parallax ~0.5x on scroll.

fill.what: mirror-law fill. outline = -webkit-text-stroke + transparent fill; solid = cream fill. read from data-fill if not passed.

gutter.what: passed to fluid-type-sizing (0 if the container already excludes gutters).

fillRatio.what: fraction of the line the word fills (passed to fluid-type-sizing).

parallax.what: word yPercent drift rate vs scroll (0 = none); needs GSAP+ScrollTrigger.

entry:
BleedingWordmark.init(target, opts) -> { words, refit }. Markup:
WORD
. Composes FluidType (sibling) for the fill if loaded.
law: transform + opacity only; GPU layer; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; reveal = overflow:hidden clip + translateY (NOT clip-path on text); reduced-motion -> word at rest. Degrades: with GSAP+ScrollTrigger does scroll reveal+parallax, else reveals on load, else static.
composes: fluid-type-sizing (fill the line) + the clip wrap; pairs with section-pager / dual-slicer / theme-tween / parallax-collage (wordmark-behind).
gate_mode: normal (the word reveals/parallaxes OVER a solid bg photo; no two-render overlap) — blank/jank/fps standard.
proven: lab: OUR words over OUR renders — архітектура (outline, stroke 1.6px cream, fill transparent, fs 261px) + тераса (solid cream, fs 445px), each filled to 1336px (width-gutters), each clip-revealing on scroll, mirror-law flip confirmed.
